# DeskVNC

> DeskVNC is a native desktop client for VNC, RDP and SSH, written in Rust on Tauri 2, running on Windows, macOS and Linux. It ships an MCP server named `dvv` that lets an AI agent drive the same connections a person uses, over the existing protocol, with nothing installed on the remote machine and a person able to take the wheel back at any moment.

## Project

- [DeskVNC on GitHub](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC): the source repository, the latest release, and every issue.
- [DeskVNC releases](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/releases/latest): signed installers for Windows, signed and notarized builds for macOS, and an x86_64 Linux tarball.
- [DeskVNC official page](https://psmux.github.io/deskvnc/): the project-maintained landing page.
- [DeskVNC issue tracker](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/issues): bug reports, interoperability findings, and feature requests.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/README.md): the full project overview, the MCP server introduction, and the verified benchmark table.
- [Install notes](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): download, checksum verification, and the permissions the app asks for.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the protocol cores, the security model, the crate layout, and the full VNC, RDP and SSH feature list.
- [AI agent integration](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md): wiring `dvv` into Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, VS Code and plain Python agents.
- [Performance notes](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): detailed measurements behind the benchmark table.
- [Diagnostics](https://github.com/psmux/DeskVNC/blob/main/docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md): troubleshooting guide for live sessions.
